content.short: Swipelux provides fiat-to-tokens on-ramp, fiat-to-NFT payment rails, a one-step wallet, and Digital ID Infrastructure.
content.description: Swipelux delivers an end-to-end onboarding toolkit that simplifies crypto adoption by combining fiat-to-tokens on-ramp, fiat-to-NFT payment rails, a streamlined one-step wallet, and built-in digital identity infrastructure. The platform aims to remove friction around wallet creation and first crypto or NFT purchases, letting users complete these steps directly within the landing dapp. No need to switch sites or jump through multiple platforms—the entire flow happens in-context, from onboarding to first purchase.
content.meta: Swipelux is a Web3 onboarding and wallet tools stack. Discover Swipelux and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
